rule: The owner’s rule: the bigger button reaches everyone, at most 45 customers hurt across the four changes, then the soonest to everyone.

reasons.canary: A bigger canary sees more checkouts, so luck matters less, but more customers meet a bad change.
reasons.bake: A longer bake waits for more checkouts before each step up.
reasons.flag: Behind a flag, the way back takes 1 minute instead of 5.
reasons.threshold: How much worse the canary must fail before the rollout rolls itself back.
